name: Asshur
overview: Asshur is identified in Scripture as a son of Shem and the progenitor of the Assyrian people, as seen in Genesis 10:22. He is credited with founding key cities such as Nineveh, Rehoboth, and Calah, which were central to the Assyrian kingdom (Genesis 10:11). Ezekiel 32:22 reflects on Asshur and his company facing judgment and defeat, emphasizing the consequences of their opposition to God's purposes.
